caveat: the harness that produced the first version of this artefact exited on its first poll because the review begins in a terminal state; fixed in tools/verify_resume.py, and the figures here are read back from Firestore rather than from that run
execution: Cloud Run dispatcher via Eventarc push; drafting on Agent Runtime engines

human_in_the_loop.resolved_via: POST /rounds/{round}/answers/{question}/approval on the deployed control plane

resumed_with_context.source: Memory Bank on the fleet orchestrator engine, migrated this session
resumed_with_context.why_it_matters: open_follow_up reads commitments before any round-2 question is drafted, and raises ContextUnavailable rather than proceeding with an empty list -- an empty list is indistinguishable from "this customer was promised nothing" and would silently disable the consistency check for the whole round

round_one.note: the seeded round-1 answers were never persisted to Firestore by the seed; the round-1 COMMITMENTS are what survived and are what round 2 reads. So "round 1 untouched" is not a meaningful check here and is not claimed.
